answer: Streak multiplier: score = base × min(streak,30). At the onyx epoch, forging k identities resets each streak to 1, so a 30-epoch honest run costs 1 identity; a sybil needs 30× parallel identities to match one. The vault locks rewards until streak≥7, making early exit forfeit 100%. At dawn each epoch, streaks verify against prior attestations. Sybils pay 30× capital for 1× yield; honest single-identity operators dominate. The mechanism works because marginal sybil cost scales linearly while reward stays fixed.
